units.source_text: 出发前二三日，源氏公子非常秘密地访问左大臣邸。

en.t: Two or three days before his departure, Prince Genji paid a very secret visit to the Left Minister's mansion.

units.source_text: 他乘坐一辆简陋的竹席车，形似侍女用的车子，偷偷地前往，样子十分可怜，别人睹此光景，恍若置身梦幻。

en.t: He went there secretly in a plain carriage with bamboo blinds, like one used by ladies-in-waiting, and his appearance was so pitiful that anyone who saw the scene felt as if they were in a dream.

units.source_text: 他走进葵姬旧居的室中，但觉景象好不凄凉！

en.t: When he entered the rooms where Lady Aoi had once lived, the sight struck him as unbearably desolate.

units.source_text: 小公子的乳母以及几个尚未散去的旧日侍女，与源氏公子久别重逢，尽皆欢喜，亲切地前来拜见。

en.t: The young lord's nurse and several former waiting women who had not yet dispersed were delighted to see Prince Genji again after so long, and came warmly to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 看了他那委顿的姿态，连知识浅陋的青年侍女也都痛感人生之无常，个个泪盈于睫。

en.t: Seeing his worn and weary appearance, even the inexperienced young waiting women felt keenly the impermanence of life, and tears filled every pair of eyes.

units.source_text: 小公子夕雾长得异常秀美，听见父亲来了，欢天喜地地跑过来。

en.t: The young lord Yugiri had grown exceptionally handsome, and when he heard that his father had come, he ran over in great delight.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，说道：“许久不见，他还认得父亲，乖得很！”

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji said, "After so long apart, he still recognizes his father. What a good child he is!"

units.source_text: 便抱起他，让他坐在膝上，样子不胜怜惜。

en.t: He then lifted the boy up and seated him on his lap, looking at him with boundless tenderness.

units.source_text: 左大臣也来了，与源氏公子面晤。

en.t: The Left Minister also came and met with Prince Genji face to face.
